title: EAP based Identification response by the UE

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to initiate authentication, containing EAP-Request/Identity or EAP-Request/AKA'-Identity.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE in response to AUTHENTICATION REQUEST, containing EAP-Response/Identity or EAP-Response/AKA'-Identity.

entities.name: EAP-Request/Identity
entities.description: EAP method requesting identity from the UE, carried in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: EAP-Response/Identity
entities.description: EAP method providing requested identity from the UE, carried in AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message.

entities.name: EAP-Request/AKA'-Identity
entities.description: EAP method for AKA' authentication requesting identity from the UE, carried in AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: EAP-Response/AKA'-Identity
entities.description: EAP method for AKA' authentication providing requested identity from the UE, carried in AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message.

entities.name: AT_PERMANENT_REQ
entities.description: Attribute in EAP-Request/AKA'-Identity indicating permanent identity request.

entities.name: EAP-Response/AKA'-Client-Error
entities.description: EAP method indicating client error with code 'unable to process packet', sent when AT_PERMANENT_REQ is received.

entities.name: AT_PERMANENT_REQ present
entities.description: Condition where EAP-Request/AKA'-Identity carries the AT_PERMANENT_REQ attribute.

relations.description: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains EAP-Request/Identity IE.
AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains EAP-Request/AKA'-Identity IE.
AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message contains EAP-Response/Identity IE.
AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message contains EAP-Response/AKA'-Identity IE.
Condition where AT_PERMANENT_REQ is present establishes sending of EAP-Response/AKA'-Client-Error.
EAP-Request/AKA'-Identity is guarded by condition of AT_PERMANENT_REQ presence.
